```{r}
#| label: load
#| message: false

library(targets)
library(tidyverse)
library(qs)
library(here)

## here::here() anchors to the project root (via open-rvfcast.Rproj) no matter
 ## what directory quarto actually executes this document from (a plain 
 ## `quarto render` or inside tar_make() via tar_quarto()
store <- here::here("model_framework_targets")

## list the figure-exporting targets here explicitly so that there is a
 ## dependence path 
targets::tar_load(c(
    model_note
  , plotted_calibration.plot_export_opt
  , plotted_calibration.plot_export_even
  , prob_dens.plot_export
  , map_split.plot_export
), store = store)

map_split_path    <- paste0("gg_map_split_", Sys.Date(), ".svg")
prob_dens_path    <- paste0("gg_prob_dens_plot_", Sys.Date(), ".svg")
calplot_even_path <- paste0("gg_calplot_even_", Sys.Date(), ".svg")
calplot_opt_path  <- paste0("gg_calplot_opt_", Sys.Date(), ".svg")

```
